text:
marta: Heads up — scheduling a 1h preflight pin/unpin window tomorrow 09:00-10:00 PDT to run runtime+model compatibility checks before the llama4q rollout. We'll do a dry-run canary (10 qps) then a wider canary (50 qps). Need owners for SDK + serving checklist. @kevin @ashok

deploybot: Scheduled maintenance window: 2026-03-21 09:00-10:00 PDT. Ticket: #INF-2483. Will pause auto-unpin during window.

ashok: Any KV cache concerns for long-seq tests? last time we saw tail latency spike on 8k seq with quantized models.

kevin: Yeah KV cache warmup was the culprit. For this run let's set cache TTL=0 (force miss) then 30s for warmup. I'll update the canary config.

sophia: +1. I'll prepare smoke prompts and evals. Also suggest running SDK v1.12.4 against runtime v2.15 canary — we saw minor tokenization diff before.

kevin: SDK bump noted. I'm going to produce a small compat matrix and release note blurb. Draft: "runtime 2.15 is compatible with SDK >=1.12.4 and models: llama4q-0.9, gpt2x-quant". Will post by EOD.

marta: Great. Can someone own rollback plan? If metrics regress, plan is: 1) pause traffic 2) unpin runtime -> fallback model 3) revert SDK route. Who's oncall for the window?

ashok: I'll be primary oncall. Kevin backup. I can run rollback steps. Please add runbook link.

marta: Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/pin-unpin-rollback (make sure to follow canary kill switch). Also add perf thresholds: p95 latency +25% or error rate >2%.

deploybot: Reminder: canary config uploaded to s3://redwood-deploys/canaries/2178001111.json

kevin: Canary command for infra:
```
infra-canary --config s3://redwood-deploys/canaries/2178001111.json --qps 10 --duration 5m --tags preflight-pin
```

sophia: I'll run evals then ping metrics slack with snapshot. cc: @release-bot

release-bot: Noted. I'll append the canary results to the release notes draft when Sophia posts results.

marta: OK lock-in: Kevin will update compat matrix + release notes. Sophia to post metric snapshot in this thread. Ashok primary rollback. We'll proceed with dry-run first. Thanks :thumbsup:

sophia: copy, will post results here after dry-run.

kevin: updated doc: https://docs.redwood/compat/2178001111-matrix (draft)

sophia: dry-run done — p95 latency +8%, error rate 0.3%. Posting snapshot: https://metrics.redwood/snapshots/xyz

marta: looks safe to proceed to canary. Moving window to start.

deploybot: Canary started at 2178001500 (10 qps). Logs: s3://redwood-logs/canary/2178001500/

ashok: monitoring. no regressions so far, KV warmup behaved as expected.

sophia: smoke evals pass. small tokenization diff in prompt#7 but quality within threshold.

kevin: release notes snippet added: "Added runtime 2.15 compatibility with SDK >=1.12.4; pinlist updated for llama4q-0.9. See compat matrix."

marta: thanks team. Unpin window scheduled next week for production rollout with same checklist.

release-bot: Release notes updated in draft: https://releases.redwood/notes/2178. QA signoff pending.

sophia: QA signoff: passed. :white_check_mark:

marta: last: tagging legal for any export note? @jackson

jackson: no export issues. thumbs up.

marta: closing thread — will create prod rollout thread tomorrow. :wave:
